author: kuroana
quote:
This game is ridiculously buggy. It has so many bugs that it feels like Cyberpunk 2077 at launch. What a disgrace. They had 13 years to work on it and delayed its release multiple times. Rockstar Games has no excuses.

The story is boring. It doesn't feel like GTA. The story is basically just Cuck Boyfriend Simulator. "Go grocery shopping, Lucia will appreciate it", "Buy her a necklace, Lucia will appreciate it", "Buy her some flowers, Lucia will appreciate it". What the hell is this?

It DOESN'T feel like GTA. It's a disappointment! These activities remind me of The Sims. In GTA 5, you pulled off heists, robbed banks and did all sorts of other stuff. It was simply a game you could switch your brain off and enjoy, and that's exactly why GTA 5 became one of the most successful games in the world.

GTA 6 is nothing like that. The endings are stupid. The language has become softer compared to GTA 5, apparently out of fear of offending minorities.
